Please post on our forums:

for questions about using `bench`, probably the best place to start is the [bench repo](https://github.com/RoyalGroupofCompanies/hera-bench) or the [bench docs](https://github.com/RoyalGroupofCompanies/hera-bench/tree/develop/docs), or open a thread in [Discussions](https://github.com/RoyalGroupofCompanies/hera-bench/discussions)

for questions about using the `Hera Framework`, see the [Hera framework repo](https://github.com/RoyalGroupofCompanies/hera)

for questions about using `ERPNext`: https://discuss.erpnext.com

For documentation issues, use the [bench docs](https://github.com/RoyalGroupofCompanies/hera-bench/tree/develop/docs)

> **Posts that are not bug reports or feature requests will not be addressed on this issue tracker.**
